semanticObligations: For every represented steelGradeRequirementCase, select the exact required grade from iacsUrI2Table8 using ship polarClass plus case asBuiltPlateThickness, steelMaterialClass and steelStrengthCategory. Missing selectors or an applicable selection without a required grade fail. The actual grade must have rank greater than or equal to the required grade only within the same steelStrengthCategory; NOT_APPLICABLE combinations impose no grade result.
